++++++++FNS 9/40 Full Size Frame by DB Firearms++++++++


This frame is designed to turn your FNS 9/40 parts kit back into functional firearms. YAY! This is for now only for the Full Size (and long slide) models and I don't have plans to support the compact frames or magazines.

NOTES ON FINDING KITS: There are two main sources for kits that will vary daily and weekly. 
1. Gunbroker search: "FNS Repair parts". There are weekly auctions that end on Sundays and kits will often appear there weekly. 
2. Everygunpart: This company will have inventory that fluctuates daily. If you are searching for a kit, it's best to look often. https://everygunpart.com/?acc=ad1288236b3a6b1d28115a1f92ab8bb6 (This is an affiliate link. I get 10% in credit back if you use it. Use code REFSV2648 for 10% off)
